text:
pd-bot: SEV2 - Regional failover monitor detected an unexpected full-cutover to eu-west-1. Condition: failover_state == \"active_full_cut\" && region_error_ratio < 0.5 && automation_trigger=true. Paging ivan (oncall). Incident page: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-4789 :rotating_light:

ivan (oncall): Ack. Wtf — the automation did a hard cut despite our soft-failover policy. Pulling logs for the automated-runner and LB controller. Tagging leah and matt.

leah: I'm seeing the automation executed `failover-controller v3` with param `--mode=hard` at 14:03 UTC. That run was triggered by an autoscaling spike in ap-south-1 earlier. Looks like a bug in the decision tree that treated the spike as systemic.

matt (sre): Consequence: eu-west received 85% of traffic for ~6m. ap-south-1 and us-east flooded with retries, ap-south error rates rose to 2.4% and some enterprise requests timed out. Rolling revert: infra-bot, can you reapply policy to restore previous weights and disable automation?

infra-bot: Disabling automated failover (action id: disable-ff-882). Reapplying weights: us-east=0.5, eu-west=0.3, ap-south=0.2. CLI output:

```bash
gwctl set-weights --region us-east-1=0.5 --region eu-west-1=0.3 --region ap-south-1=0.2 --annotate "rollback after unintended hard-cut"
# change committed (tx: e7c2f3)
```

ivan (oncall): We also need to mute duplicate alerts — PD got both failover monitor and per-AZ NLB pages. For now, I'll mute per-AZ alerts to the oncall channel and keep the regional pages only.

leah: Adding immediate mitigation: revert the automation config and add a safety check to prevent hard-mode unless >2 regions show >1.5% 5xx for 5m. Creating PR for automation gate.

matt (sre): Observed client-side retry storms from SDK v2 clients. Applying edge circuit-breaker rule to limit retries per-IP and instruct SDK to backoff. Support, can you surface SDK versions in open tickets?

support: Will gather SDK data and tag impacted customers. We already have 9 inbound tickets mentioning timeouts. Creating OPS ticket OPS-5280 for customer follow-up.

pd-bot: Update: eu-west 5xx at 0.27% after rollback. ap-south 5xx down from 2.4% to 0.7% after partial reroute and edge rules. No pages in last 14m.

ivan (oncall): Good. Now for follow-ups: 1) automation bugfix + safety gate (owner: leah) 2) alert tuning to reduce noise and add dedupe labels (owner: matt) 3) new multi-region failover dashboard with weight timeline and annotated automation runs (owner: infra) 4) runbook update and drill for soft vs hard failover (owner: ivan) 5) customer comms (owner: support).

leah: Draft automation fix: require `--mode=hard` to be explicitly approved by an operator or if all these are true: (a) >=2 regions error_ratio > 1.5% for 5m, (b) >50% AZs in each region showing degraded health, (c) manual confirm header present. Pushing PR: https://git.redwood.example/infra/failover/pull/412

matt (sre): For alert tuning I'm proposing these immediate changes to reduce duplicates and noise:
- Add label `dedupe=regional` and `source=failover_monitor` to regional alerts.
- Suppress per-AZ nlb-health pages for region if regional failover alert is firing (suppress window 8m).
- Increase NLB failure threshold from 4 -> 7 checks to avoid deploy churn noise.
- Use a 5m rolling aggregation window for region-level 5xx alerts with a 10m cooldown.

ivan (oncall): Sounds good. Matt, add `notify: oncall` to alert annotations so PD routes it correctly. Also include `impact: possible-customer-latency` for triage templates.

matt (sre): Will open PR for alerts: https://git.redwood.example/sre/alerts/pull/389 with draft rule:

```yaml
- alert: RegionalFailoverTrigger
  expr: (sum by(region)(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))) * 100 > 0.8
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    dedupe: regional
    source: failover_monitor
  annotations:
    summary: "{{ $labels.region }} aggregated 5xx > 0.8% (5m)"
    notify: oncall
    impact: "possible-customer-latency"
    cooldown: "10m"
    suppress_per_az: "true"
```

leah: For the automation PR I added a unit test that simulates single-region spikes and ensures mode remains soft. Please review.

infra: Dashboard work - I'll add a weight timeline that plots planned vs actual weights, plus a swimlane for automation runs (with mode and initiator). Putting it under SRE -> Failover -> Regional Health. Link draft: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ghijkl/regional-failover.

support: Preparing customer note draft: "We observed elevated error rates for some regions during an automated traffic cutover. Mitigation included rollback and temporary traffic rebalancing. We're investigating automation safeguards and will follow up." Ticket OPS-5280 updated.

ivan (oncall): One more ops change: add an automation dry-run mode that logs decisions to a `failover-sim` stream for 24h before allowing hard cuts. Leah, can you add that to the PR?

leah: Yes, adding `--dry-run-log` flag and a 24h audit stream. Will include in PR description and link to tests.

pd-bot: Incident update: mitigated. Metrics stable for 20m. No new pages. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-4789/postmortem

matt (sre): Quick note on alerts — once PR merges I'll coordinate with PD routing to group alerts by `dedupe` label so we don't double-page. Also will include before/after noise counts in the postmortem.

infra: I logged a dashboard ticket DSH-1187 to add weight-change annotation ingestion from gwctl so historical runs show up automatically. Owner: infra.

ivan (oncall): Handing off to night oncall at 22:00 UTC. Checklist left in the incident ticket: automation disabled, rollback confirmed, edge retry rules in place, alert suppression active, PRs opened (leah/matt), dashboard draft (infra), customer ticket OPS-5280. Escalate if region >1% again or automation is re-enabled.

support: We'll send the customer blurb to impacted enterprise contacts by EOD and monitor for replies.

leah: PR for automation changes: https://git.redwood.example/infra/failover/pull/412 (includes safety gate, dry-run logging, and test cases).

matt (sre): Alerts PR: https://git.redwood.example/sre/alerts/pull/389. Please review today so we can merge and reduce noise.

ivan (oncall): Thanks team. We'll do a follow-up postmortem and a drill for automation behavior in the next sprint. Closing active mitigation channel. :thumbsup:
